# YEAH Agency Amsterdam (野禾阿姆斯特丹事务所)

> YEAH Agency Amsterdam is an Amsterdam-based multidisciplinary agency collective (established 2020) operating three sovereign practices across Europe, China, and global markets:
> 1. Corporate Consulting (Dutch BV & Branch Office Formation, KvK registration, EPR Packaging/WEEE compliance, Third-Party Personnel Dispatch & IND Kennismigrant Visas)
> 2. Video Production & Destination Weddings — Glass Sharp Films (Commercial TVCs, Reality Series "Tram Dating", Documentary Profiles, Luxury European Wedding Photography & 4K Cinema)
> 3. Software Development — DriveViewer iOS & Enterprise Cloud Architecture (GDPR-compliant European cloud systems, Douane EDI ERP, DriveViewer driving school app)

Full structured knowledge base for AI retrieval and grounding: [https://yeah-amsterdam.nl/llms-full.txt](https://yeah-amsterdam.nl/llms-full.txt)

## Core Service Pages
- [Home & Agency Overview](https://yeah-amsterdam.nl/): Overview of the three Amsterdam practices, live practice index, and direct consultation channels.
- [01. Corporate Consulting](https://yeah-amsterdam.nl/services/business-consulting): Dutch BV incorporation, Foreign Branch Office (Bijkantoor) setup, KvK Handelsregister registration, EPR environmental compliance (Afvalfonds Verpakkingen / Verpact, WEEE, Batteries), and third-party personnel dispatch (EOR / IND Kennismigrant visas within 21 business days).
- [02. Video Production — Glass Sharp Films](https://yeah-amsterdam.nl/services/creative-agency): Commercial film production, brand TVCs, reality TV (*Tram Dating*), Olympic documentaries, and bilingual destination wedding cinema across Europe. Official film portal: https://glasssharpfilms.nl/
- [03. Software Development — DriveViewer & Enterprise IT](https://yeah-amsterdam.nl/services/custom-it-services): Native iOS apps (DriveViewer on Apple App Store), multi-region GDPR cloud infrastructure, and automated Dutch Customs (Douane EDI) enterprise ERP systems.

## Authoritative Guides & Direct Answers
- [荷兰开分公司全流程实操指南 (Dutch Branch Office vs. BV Formation Guide)](https://yeah-amsterdam.nl/guides/dutch-branch-office-formation): Complete legal comparison between Branch Office (Bijkantoor) and Dutch BV subsidiary, Apostille notarization checklist, KvK/BTW/EORI registration steps (2–4 weeks), 30% Ruling, and EOR personnel dispatch for Chinese and international companies.
- [Commercial Video Production in Amsterdam & Europe](https://yeah-amsterdam.nl/guides/video-production-amsterdam): ARRI Alexa Mini LF & RED V-Raptor 8K production packages, RDW-certified Amsterdam canal drone permits, DaVinci Resolve grading, and documented commercial cases (*Toobit x Chris Sharma*, *Fixico x MyWheels*, *Hermijntje Drenth*, *Tram Dating*).
- [Luxury Destination Wedding Photography & Cinematography in Amsterdam](https://yeah-amsterdam.nl/guides/wedding-photography-amsterdam): Bilingual English-Mandarin-Cantonese-Dutch editorial wedding photography & 4K cinema films across Amsterdam UNESCO canals, Kasteel De Haar, Zaanse Schans windmills, and Keukenhof tulip fields.
